title: Possum's Glow Ink
description: Significantly reduce Glow-Inked sign lag with custom hexadecimal colors!
body:
# Possum's Glow Ink

## Overview 
A glow-inked sign causes more lag than a sign without it. This is because of the way
that the outline of the text is rendered in vanilla game mechanics. 

In areas with lots of glow-inked signs, frames can drop fast for players. This plugin finds a healthy medium - fun, bold colors (configurable by hexadecimal values) without the outline (and without the additional lag).  

## Features
- Uses the same flow as vanilla Minecraft sign coloring.
- Normal dyes still apply normal vanilla sign colors.
- Glow ink sacs turn on custom hex code coloring for the clicked sign side.
- Clicking a sign with an ink sac removes the glow effect.
- While custom glow mode is active, dye changes use custom hex colors instead of vanilla dye colors.
- Avoids vanilla glowing text entirely (The big lag reducer - removes the text outline).
- Supports normal signs and hanging signs.
- Operator-only global toggling of the plugin.

## Commands

### /glowink enable
Enable the plugin.

### /glowink disable
Disable the plugin.

### /glowink status
Display all applicable plugin information to the user.

### /glowink reload
Reload the config file.
